title: It's the Holy Ghost and fire

lines.text: Its the Holy Ghost and fire that is
Keeping me alive (3)
Its the Holy Ghost and fire that is
Keeping me alive,
Jesus is keeping me alive.
Alleluia (3)
Alleluia, Alleluia
Praise the Lord. } 2
He is all over me and Hes
Keeping me alive (3)
He is all over me and Hes
Keeping me alive
Jesus is keeping me alive.
I have been baptized in the water
In the name of the Lord (3)
I have been baptized in the water
In the name of the Lord,
In the name of the Saviour Jesus Christ.
I have been baptized in the Spirit
In the name of the Lord (3)
I have been baptized in the Spirit
In the name of the Lord
In the name of the Saviour Jesus Christ.
